prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: corrected high-fidelity north-star composition for a native Windows 11 WinUI 3 desktop application
Primary request: Redesign composition option B for Codex Tweaks using Microsoft Store package browsing clarity and current Windows 11 Fluent controls. Show the real “功能包” screen with a standard left NavigationView, Mica base layer, transparent Page, compact page header, native CommandBar, environment InfoBar, SearchBox, and a scannable ListView. IMPORTANT: the repository contains exactly one package, ct-sample, so render exactly one package row and an honest summary of 已启用 0 / 1，已激活 0. The single package row uses a native ToggleSwitch, name/version, status, a plain TextBox for priority with no spinner arrows, and contextual buttons for 打开目录 and 编译. A details region for the selected ct-sample can appear below the row. Developer mode is a separate ToggleSwitch in the page command/status area, never a table column.
Composition/framing: landscape Windows desktop app window, 3:2 viewport, entire first viewport visible. Calm mouse-and-keyboard productivity density with meaningful empty space after the single real package.
Text (verbatim, use only these real product strings): “Codex Tweaks”, “概览”, “功能包”, “运行日志”, “关于与更新”, “按包管理页面增强”, “已启用 0 / 1，已激活 0”, “重新扫描”, “安装本地包”, “从 Git 安装”, “检查远程更新”, “开发者模式”, “优先级”, “打开目录”, “编译”, “ct-sample”, “codex_tweaks 示例”, “尚未编译”. Other copy must be gray placeholder lines.
Color palette: system Windows 11 light theme, Mica pale gray, layered white/near-white surface, system blue accent, semantic status colors sparingly.
Constraints: exactly one package row, no invented package rows or metrics, no NumberBox/spinner, unmistakably native WinUI 3, real Fluent icons and control proportions, accessible hierarchy, no watermark.
Avoid: web data table, SaaS dashboard, bento grid, nested cards, excessive pills, neon terminal, oversized hero, gradients, glossy glass, custom fonts, emoji.
